# Verify the result
number = 31720986418951
divisor = 123
result = number % divisor

# Double-check by division
quotient = number // divisor
remainder = number - (quotient * divisor)

print(f"{number} = {quotient} × {divisor} + {remainder}")
print(f"\nVerification: {remainder} = {result} ✓" if remainder == result else f"\nVerification failed!")
EOF
